headline: SILVER CRASHES TO 70:1 RATIO VS GOLD — Down 50% From Jan Peak; Sixth Straight Deficit 46M oz Yet Iran/Fed Crush Industrial Bid
snippet: Silver fell 1.4% on July 15 to $56.84 while gold held essentially flat at $4,035, pushing the gold-silver ratio to 70:1 — near the ceiling of its 50-year historical range. The move extends silver's 50% collapse from its January 2026 peak, as Iran military escalation stokes inflation fears that keep real yields elevated, hammering silver's industrial demand outlook harder than gold's pure safe-haven bid. The Silver Institute confirmed the sixth consecutive annual supply deficit at 46.3 million ounces, a structural support bulls say sets up a sharp snapback when sentiment turns.

headline: FOUNDERS METALS ANTINO NORTHEAST CONFIRMED — 58.5m AT 1.00 g/t Au Opens 4th Active Gold Target in Suriname District (TSXV:FDR)
snippet: Founders Metals (TSXV: FDR) published a mid-year update from its fully-funded 70,000-metre 2026 drill campaign at the Antino Gold Project in southeastern Suriname, confirming a new system at Antino Northeast — discovery hole ANE009 returned 58.5 metres at 1.00 g/t gold from 18.6 metres depth, 1,200 metres from the core Upper Antino resource. Three additional zones are simultaneously active: Antino North (8.1m at 3.42 g/t from surface), Maria Geralda (deep auger expansion), and Antino West (53.1m at 1.21 g/t confirmed in June), expanding Antino into a multi-target district.

headline: FED SPLIT 9-8 ON RATE HIKE — Near-Miss FOMC Vote Sent Gold Below $4,000 and Silver to Multi-Month Lows
snippet: Minutes from the June Federal Reserve FOMC meeting, released July 14, revealed that 9 of 17 governors favoured an immediate rate hike — one vote short of the majority needed for action — marking the closest the Committee has come to hiking during the current pause. The disclosure amplified selling pressure on precious metals already weighed down by the Iran conflict's oil-inflation-yield feedback loop, with gold touching $3,990 before stabilising and silver logging its largest single-session decline since June. July 28-29 FOMC rate-hike odds re-priced sharply higher before retreating on soft CPI data.

headline: AZTEC TOMBSTONE OXIDE ZONE: 155m AT 1.08 g/t Au + 30 g/t Ag — 11-Hole Program Expands Contention Target, SE Arizona (TSXV:AZT)
snippet: Aztec Minerals Corp. (TSXV: AZT) released results from 11 drill holes in the 2025-2026 campaign at its Tombstone Property in southeastern Arizona, with the Contention zone delivering consistently wide, shallow oxide gold-silver mineralisation — best intercept 155.4 metres at 1.08 g/t gold and 30.23 g/t silver (1.63 g/t AuEq) from near-surface. The shallow oxide character and robust widths position Tombstone for potential low-cost heap-leach development in a historic Arizona district, with results showing the Contention deposit remains open for expansion in multiple directions.

headline: SOUTHERN CROSS GOLD DRILLS 250m OF COSTERFIELD-STYLE GOLD-ANTIMONY DEPTH AT REDCASTLE — 17km Goldfield Belt Tested for First Time (TSX:SXGC / ASX:SX2)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Southern Cross Gold
snippet: Southern Cross Gold Consolidated (TSX: SXGC / ASX: SX2) released the first diamond drill results from beneath the 100%-owned Redcastle Project in Victoria, Australia, confirming Costerfield-style gold-antimony mineralisation in narrow, high-grade veins across more than 250 metres of vertical extent in hole SDDRE016 — with eight individual high-grade intervals including 26.2 g/t gold. The Redcastle Project hosts 14 individual reefs across a 900-metre cross-strike corridor and 17 km of historic working-level extent, the vast majority of which has never been tested below 50 metres depth, opening a large target pipeline analogous to the producing Costerfield mine.

headline: CHILE'S COPPER OUTPUT SINKING — Escondida -16%, Collahuasi -11% YoY; $6.34/lb Copper Hits 3-Week High on 43,000t Combined Shortfall
snippet: Copper futures climbed to $6.34 per pound on July 16 — a three-week high — as Chile's May output fell nearly 13% year-on-year: BHP's Escondida shed 16% to 101,600 tonnes and the Collahuasi JV fell 11% to 31,400 tonnes, creating a combined shortfall of 43,000 metric tonnes against prior-year levels. Chile accounts for roughly 50% of global copper exports, and the combination of water shortages in the Atacama, accelerating ore grade decline, transition from oxide to sulphide mining, and renewed labour disputes is tracking well below Cochilco's full-year 5.3-million-tonne output forecast.

headline: GALLEON GOLD ZONE #9 EXTENDS 360m DOWN-PLUNGE TO 500m DEPTH — South Zone Footprint Also Grows; Timmins West Camp Delivers (TSXV:GGO)
snippet: Galleon Gold Corp. (TSXV: GGO) announced July 15 that 2026 drilling has confirmed down-dip continuity at Zone #9 of the West Cache Gold Project — 13 km west of Timmins — extending the zone 360 metres down-plunge (350 metres down-dip) from planned bulk-sample stopes to a vertical depth of 500 metres, well beyond the current resource model. The 18,000-metre 2026 program is simultaneously expanding the South Zone footprint, adding to an earlier May result of 16.07 g/t gold over 9.25 metres that confirmed the system's high-grade core at depth.

headline: US RARE EARTH STOCKS +81% IN H1 2026 — Project Vault, China Export Bans Powered the Run; NdPr at 2026 Highs Even as USAR Gives Back 20%
snippet: NAI 500 analysis confirms US-listed rare earth equities returned an average 81% gain in H1 2026, driven by the Trump administration's $12 billion Project Vault strategic stockpile initiative, escalating Chinese rare earth export restrictions, and production milestones from USA Rare Earth (USAR) and Energy Fuels (UUUU). The sector has given back as much as 20% since June 30 as Iran-driven cross-commodity volatility bites, but NdPr alloy, neodymium, and praseodymium all set new 2026 price highs in early July — with zero of the 18 tracked rare earth elements declining in the first week of the month.

headline: HANNAN FILES PERU'S FIRST ALKALINE EPITHERMAL DRILL APPLICATION — 7,650m DIA at Previsto; Gold-Copper System Class Includes World's Biggest Mines (TSXV:HAN)
snippet: Hannan Metals Ltd. (TSXV: HAN) submitted its Declaración de Impacto Ambiental (DIA) on July 14 — the primary environmental permit required for drilling in Peru — covering an 18-platform, 7,650-metre diamond drill program across the Previsto Central and Inca Garcilazo targets in Huánuco region. Previsto is the first documented alkaline epithermal gold-copper system in Peru, a deposit class that hosts some of the world's largest and highest-grade gold mines; DIA approval and full drilling commencement is anticipated in Q1 2027.

headline: GOLD SWOT: DPM METALS BEATS Q2 GUIDANCE — Weekly Roundup Tracks Which Miners Are Holding Margins at $4,000 Gold
snippet: VanEck's weekly Gold SWOT analysis, syndicated on GoldSeek, highlights Dundee Precious Metals (TSX: DPM) delivering above-guidance Q2 2026 gold-copper production from its Ada Tepe (Bulgaria) and Zod (Azerbaijan) operations as one of the sector's positive Q2 surprises — even as the broader GDX and GDXJ indices absorbed double-digit monthly declines in June. The roundup assesses how low-cost operators with base metal by-product credits are preserving margins near $4,000 gold while leveraged juniors face acute earnings compression.
